arxiv-2105-05373.title: Estimation of population size based on capture recapture designs and evaluation of the estimation reliability
arxiv-2105-05373.creator: Yue You, Mark van der Laan, Philip Collender, Qu Cheng, Alan Hubbard, Nicholas P Jewell, Zhiyue Tom Hu, Robin Mejia, Justin Remais
arxiv-2105-05373.description: Abstract We propose a modern method to estimate population size based on capture-recapture designs of K samples. The observed data is formulated as a sample of n i.i.d. K-dimensional vectors of binary indicators, where the k-th component of each vector indicates the subject being caught by the k-th sample, such that only subjects with nonzero capture vectors are observed.

arxiv-2105-07421.title: CORRECTIONS TO MODELS OF B-PHYSICS DECAY ANOMALIES
arxiv-2105-07421.creator: NUDŽEIM SELIMOVIĆ
arxiv-2105-07421.description: Abstract Motivated by the recent anomalies observed in semileptonic decays of B-mesons, the class of models denoted as ”4321” is introduced and analysed. The importance of calculating next-to-leading-order (NLO) effects in performing precise compatibility tests of data with 4321 predictions is discussed.

arxiv-2202-01904.title: A Note on the Conditional Probabilities of the Telegraph Process Submitted to Statistics and Probability Letters; version of February 3, 2022
arxiv-2202-01904.creator: Fabrizio Cinque
arxiv-2202-01904.description: Abstract We consider the telegraph process with two velocities, a 1 > a 2 ∈ ℝ a_{1}>a_{2}\in\mathbb{R} , and two rates of reversal, λ 1 , λ 2 > 0 \lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}>0 . We study some of its features with respect to the conditional probability measure where both the initial speed and the number of changes of direction are known.

arxiv-2210-14077.title: Eigen Memory Trees
arxiv-2210-14077.creator: Mark Rucker, Jordan T. Ash, John Langford, Paul Mineiro, Ida Momennejad
arxiv-2210-14077.description: Abstract This work introduces the Eigen Memory Tree (EMT), a novel online memory model for sequential learning scenarios. EMTs store data at the leaves of a binary tree and route new samples through the structure using the principal components of previous experiences, facilitating efficient (logarithmic) access to relevant memories.

arxiv-2211-12463.title: Notes on Fock space
arxiv-2211-12463.creator: Peter Tingley
arxiv-2211-12463.description: Abstract . These notes are intended as a fairly self-contained explanation of Fock space and various algebras that act on it, including a Clifford algebra, a Weyl algebra, an infinite rank matrix algebra, and an affine Kac-Moody algebra. We also discuss how the various algebras are related, and in particular describe the celebrated boson-fermion correspondence.

pmc-11438259.description: BackgroundThe karyotype is a major determinant of prognosis in myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS). Details of the cytogenetic profile of MDS in South Asia are limited because cytogenetic services are not widely available.MethodsWe performed a retrospective analysis of the cytogenetic and clinicopathologic profile of adult primary MDS seen consecutively at a tertiary-care centre in South India between 2003 and 2017.

pmc-11606186.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). pmc-12607793.description: Background: Gout and asymptomatic hyperuricemia (AH) are common conditions for elevated levels of uric acid in the blood. This study aimed to estimate and determine the knowledge and treatment of AH versus gout among physicians in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-12693604.title: Data-Driven Classification of Solubility Space in Deep Eutectic Solvents: Deciphering Driving Forces Using PCA and K-Means Clustering
pmc-12693604.creator: Piotr Cysewski, Maciej Przybyłek, Tomasz Jeliński, Boris Solomonov, Maria Camilla Bergonzi, Dorota Warmińska, Iwona Cichowska-Kopczyńska, Maciej Smiechowski
pmc-12693604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study presents a robust, data-driven framework for classifying and predicting drug solubility in deep eutectic solvents (DESs), moving beyond empirical approaches to enable rational formulation design. By analyzing 2010 solubility measurements of 21 diverse pharmaceutical compounds across numerous choline chloride, betaine, and menthol-based DESs, we employed Principal Component Analysis to reduce 16 COSMO-RS-derived descriptors into four chemically interpretable dimensions explaining 86.7% of the total variance.

pmc-13278703.creator: Osama Elazzouny, Joseph D. Tobias, Ibrahim Abdullah
pmc-13278703.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). An aberrant right subclavian artery (ARSA) is the most common congenital anomaly of a left aortic arch. Given the anatomical course of the ARSA, it generally remains asymptomatic throughout life without hemodynamic or respiratory effects. We report the intraoperative diagnosis of ASRA during surgery for congenital heart disease when there was dampening of the waveform from the right radial arterial cannula during transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe placement.

pmc-13342644.creator: Joanne L Parker, Justin C Deme, Bjarne Feddersen, Susan M Lea, Simon Newstead
pmc-13342644.description: GDP-Mannose transporters are Golgi-localised solute carriers that are essential for the virulence of pathogenic fungi, serving as critical components of fungal glycosylation pathways.
